rule: Pricing may adjust by country, currency, purchasing-power tier, partner program, or manual hardship review. Pricing must not adjust by language alone.
first_version_checkout_rule: No automatic live checkout price changes until country, currency, Stripe, support, and abuse controls are approved.

tiers.description: Default K-KUT / HUG pricing for standard checkout and unknown or unsupported regions.
Adjusted access pricing for reviewed regional affordability contexts.
tiers.notes: Do not enable publicly until pricing and Stripe behavior are reviewed.

tiers.description: Deeper adjusted pricing for community, school, ministry, nonprofit, memorial, or special campaign access.
Manual-only sponsored, hardship, partner, nonprofit, grief, memorial, or donor-supported access.
tiers.notes: Never fully automate in first version.

public_copy.fair_access_available: Fair-access pricing may be available by country.
public_copy.manual_review: Some access pricing requests may require manual review.
public_copy.no_language_discount: Language selection does not determine price.
